People scan a menu for 'you are here'. Colour alone fails some users, so expose the state to assistive tech too.
Set aria-current='page' on the matching link and style it with weight or an underline as well as colour.
Highlight with colour only, or leave all links identical.
A breadcrumb trail helps when pages sit three or more levels down. On a flat five-page site it is clutter and fits our lint of decoration.
Use a nav with aria-label='Breadcrumb' and an ordered list; skip it on one-level sites.
Add breadcrumbs to a site with one level.
A tall pinned header eats a phone screen and can cover focused items. Keep it short and reserve space for anchors.
Cap a sticky header near 56 to 72px and set scroll-padding-top to match.
Pin a 140px header with a banner under it.
People expect Back to undo the last navigation. Replacing history on every filter click or trapping it breaks that.
Push history entries for meaningful state changes and avoid replaceState loops.
Filters, tabs and search terms in the URL let people share, bookmark and return to a view. State kept in memory is lost on refresh.
Reflect filters, sort and page in the query string.
Keep selected filters only in component state.
Anchors take you somewhere and support open-in-new-tab; buttons do something on the page. Mixing them breaks middle-click and screen reader expectations.
Use a with href for navigation and button for actions.
Use a with href='#' and a click handler as a button.
Mobile Menu Is a Real Disclosure
A hamburger that toggles a menu should say whether it is open, be keyboard operable and close on Escape.
Use a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; close on Escape and outside click.
Use a div icon that toggles a class.
Seven or more top-level items bury what matters. Group and trim, and place the key action as a distinct button.
Limit the top bar to about five links plus one action, and move the rest into the footer.
List every page in the header.
Tabs use arrow keys between tabs and Tab into the panel. Plain links styled as tabs do not behave this way.
Use role=tablist, tab, tabpanel with roving tabindex, or use real links if each tab is a page.
Build tabs from divs with click only.
Visitors click the logo to get back. It should link to the home page and carry an accessible name.
Wrap the logo in a link to / with alt that names the business.
Leave the logo as an unlinked image.
A long list with only 'Next' leaves people lost. Show page numbers or a count, and label the nav.
Use nav aria-label='Pagination' with aria-current on the current page and a total count.
Offer infinite scroll with no footer reach.
Anchor Jumps Land Below Fixed Bars
In-page links that scroll a heading under a pinned header hide it. scroll-margin on targets fixes it.
Set scroll-margin-top on anchored headings equal to header height.
Scroll with JavaScript offsets that break on zoom.
Animated scrolling can disorient people with vestibular conditions. Apply it only when they have not asked for less motion.
Set scroll-behavior:smooth inside a no-preference media query.
Force smooth scroll on html for everyone.
Open in New Tab Only With Warning
Opening a new window without saying so confuses people who use a screen reader and breaks Back. Offer it only when it helps and say so.
Add 'opens in new tab' text and rel='noopener'.
Open external links in a new tab silently.
Random z-index values escalate into 9999 wars. A short named scale keeps dropdowns, sticky bars, modals and toasts in order.
Define 5 to 6 layer tokens and use only those.
Add a bigger number whenever something hides.
A parent with transform, opacity or filter creates a stacking context that traps children's z-index. This explains most 'why is it behind' bugs.
Inspect parents when layering fails and move overlays to the top level with a portal or dialog.
Raise z-index on the child repeatedly.
overflow:hidden on a wrapper also cuts off focus rings and dropdowns that extend beyond its box.
Use overflow:clip with padding, or add padding so rings fit inside.
Hide overflow on a card that contains buttons without room for outlines.
Images, ads and late content that push text down as they load cause misclicks and hurt Cumulative Layout Shift.
Set width and height or aspect-ratio on media and reserve slots for embeds.
Let images load with no dimensions.
On phones, 100vh includes the hidden address bar, so full-height sections spill. dvh tracks the visible area.
Use min-height:100dvh with a vh fallback.
Use 100vh for hero heights on mobile.
Cap Line Width, Not Page Width
Edge-to-edge text on a wide monitor is hard to track. Limit the container for reading and let imagery go wider.
Give text containers max-width near 65ch and centre them.
URLs, emails and long words in narrow columns burst out and force horizontal scroll.
Use overflow-wrap:anywhere on user-generated content cells.
Grid and Flex Children Need min-width 0
Flex and grid items default to min-width:auto, so a long child stretches the whole row. Set min-width:0 to let it shrink.
Add min-width:0 to children that hold text, tables or code.
Clip with overflow hidden to hide the stretch.
Notches and home indicators overlap fixed bars on modern phones. env() gives the insets.
Pad bottom bars with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and use viewport-fit=cover.
Pin a tab bar flush to the screen edge.
Spacing chosen per element gives a page that feels slightly off. A 4 or 8 pixel scale keeps rhythm.
Use spacing tokens and keep related items closer than unrelated ones.
Set margins to arbitrary values like 13px and 27px.
Every band at the same height and padding reads as a template. Let content decide each section's size.
Vary section density, width and alignment, based on what each says.
Stack identical full-width bands: heading, three cards, repeat.
